audit.why: Wukong 1-5 with the flip at Level 6, Skill at first item, Yi at 2+ items. phases[].side and win[] already agree row for row with the packet chart.
Level 6 Highlander then Kraken/BORK on Yi's side, level 3 combo and first bruiser item on his — matches where the chart flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content mid says Cyclone 'interrupts your Highlander channel' and spikes[1] says it 'interrupts your Highlander charge'.
audit.why: Highlander has no channel or charge-up — Riot's text is an instant self-buff granting move and attack speed and slow immunity. The only interruptible thing in Master Yi's kit is Meditate (W), which any CC cancels. A player told to fear an ult interrupt will hold Highlander back for no reason and still lose the Meditate.
audit.corrected: Both re-keyed: the knockup cancels Meditate, Highlander is instant, and Alpha Strike's untargetable window is the actual answer to the knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: His burst opens with the reset, so the wind-up animation is the tell to step out — waiting for the ability cast means you have already eaten it.

edits.before: His armor-shred makes your early autos hit for almost nothing while his combo chunks you — never take a short trade levels 1-3 where his Q is up.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to back off, not the cast — and its shred leaves your early autos worth nothing. No trades 1-3.

edits.before: TRICKY (47.51% WR) — Wukong owns the early lane with armor-shred and lockdown, but Master Yi survives to his on-hit spike and flips the 2+ items window; win it by farming patiently and timing Alpha Strike on Cyclone.
edits.after: TRICKY (48.54% WR) — Wukong owns the early lane with armor-shred and lockdown, but Master Yi survives to his on-hit spike and flips the 2+ items window; win it by farming patiently and timing Alpha Strike on Cyclone.

edits.before: He keeps the edge through 6 because Cyclone (R) interrupts your Highlander channel and his W clone eats your burst; only at 5 do your resets and attack speed start to flip extended trades.
edits.after: He keeps the edge through 6 because Cyclone's knockup cancels Meditate — Highlander itself is instant and cannot be interrupted — and his clone eats your burst; only at 5 do attack speed and resets flip extended trades.

edits.before: Cyclone (R) is a knockup-and-spin AoE that interrupts your Highlander charge and can flip a fight, but if you Alpha Strike into his Warrior Trickster (W) clone you dodge his burst and reset the trade in your favor.
edits.after: Cyclone (R) knocks you up and can flip a fight — the knockup cancels Meditate, though Highlander is instant and nothing interrupts it. Alpha Strike is untargetable in flight, so blink as he spins instead of eating it.
